code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), mild anemia with microcytosis and low MCHC, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated ferritin, monocytes, basophils, and alkaline phosphatase, and a slightly elevated INR. These findings suggest significant respiratory compromise with possible underlying infection/inflammation and mild liver involvement. Urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
